proposals.before: The city garrison clamored to join Chen Youlong, but Ershu pulled his men back to hold Baqing, asked Youde for reinforcements, and fought the enemy to a standstill on the Ziyang River.
proposals.after: The city garrison clamored to join Chen Youlong, but Ershu pulled his men back to hold Baoqing, asked Youde for reinforcements, and fought the enemy to a standstill on the Ziyang River.
proposals.reason: 寶慶 is Baoqing, not Baqing; the idiomatic rendering misspells the place name.

proposals.before: Censor He Kehua memorialized again, accusing Yanzhu of treating the rebels Shi Jiqing and Guan Desheng Fu too lightly and of releasing Wang Tianfu and Han Wangxi without punishment; lumped together with the Jintan affair, Yanzhu was also sentenced to strangulation.
proposals.after: Censor He Kehua memorialized again, accusing Yanzhu of applying light statutes to the rebel criminals Shi Jiqing and Guan Desheng, and of releasing Wang Tianfu and Han Wangxi without punishment; lumped together with the Jintan affair, Yanzhu was also sentenced to strangulation.
proposals.reason: 傅輕比 means applied a light statutory comparison, not a personal name Fu; Guan Desheng Fu wrongly fuses the verb phrase into the name.

proposals.before: Censor He Kehua again memorialized impeaching Yanzhu for leniently comparing the rebel criminals Shi Jiqing and Guan Desheng Fu, and for releasing without sentence Wang Tianfu and Han Wangxi; together with the Jintan case he too was sentenced to strangulation.
proposals.after: Censor He Kehua again memorialized impeaching Yanzhu for applying light comparisons to the rebel criminals Shi Jiqing and Guan Desheng, and for releasing without sentence Wang Tianfu and Han Wangxi; together with the Jintan case he too was sentenced to strangulation.
proposals.reason: Same error as idiomatic: 傅輕比 is a legal verb phrase, not part of Guan Desheng's name.

proposals.before: When the Dantu rebel Wang Zai rose in arms, Tikun again sent dozens of clerks and elders to offer submission—and they looted the treasury and fled.
proposals.after: When the Dantu rebel Wang Zaixing rose in arms, Tikun again sent dozens of clerks and elders to offer submission—and they looted the treasury and fled.
proposals.reason: 王再興 is the personal name Wang Zaixing; splitting it as Wang Zai plus 興兵 misreads the name.

proposals.before: At Shanchansi in Shanquan, Yixing, monks were locked in a land dispute with powerful families; a mob burned the temple and killed monks. The magistrate reported an uprising and senior officials prepared to send troops.
proposals.after: In the Shanquan mountains of Yixing, temple monks were locked in a land dispute with powerful families; a mob burned the temple and killed monks. The magistrate reported an uprising and senior officials prepared to send troops.
proposals.reason: 善權山中寺 means a temple in the Shanquan mountains, not a place-name Shanchansi.

proposals.before: Seeing those who had once shaved their heads in the Ming style, Pengju said: "These are innocent people caught up in the affair—they should be spared."
proposals.after: Seeing those who had already shaved their heads, Pengju said: "These are innocent people caught up in the affair—they should be spared."
proposals.reason: 薙發 refers to the Qing-required queue tonsure of submission, not a Ming hairstyle; the idiomatic gloss invents Ming style.

decisions.reason: s0006 has 退守寶慶; 寶慶 is Baoqing, so Baqing is a misspelling. The proposed replacement corrects only that place name.

s0065 reads 讞從叛罪人史記青、管得勝傅輕比: 管得勝 is the personal name and 傅輕比 is the legal verb phrase for applying a light statutory comparison. Guan Desheng Fu wrongly fuses 傅 into the name; the proposed idiomatic wording removes that error and renders 傅輕比 accurately.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 讞從叛罪人史記青、管得勝傅輕比

decisions.reason: Same parsing as the idiomatic line: after 管得勝 the text continues with 傅輕比, a legal verb phrase, not a name element Fu. The proposed literal replacement correctly ends the name at Guan Desheng and renders 傅輕比 as applying light comparisons.
s0056 has 丹徒亂民王再興兵起: 王再興 is the three-character personal name, followed by 兵起. Reading 王再 plus 興兵 mis-splits the name; Wang Zaixing is the correct restoration.
s0115 has 宜興善權山中寺僧: 善權山中寺 means a temple in the Shanquan mountains of Yixing, not a toponym Shanchansi. The proposed wording restores that reading without inventing a place name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 宜興善權山中寺僧與豪族爭地

decisions.reason: s0143 has 嘗薙發者: 薙發 is the Qing-required tonsure/queue, evidence of submission as 良民. The idiomatic gloss invents Ming style, which the Chinese does not support; removing that phrase corrects the error.
